shots.text: On the Kharum Terraces Gorrath came down the steps himself. He had gone to the Rift two years ago and come back with his heart cut out and a carved stone in its place. When it cracked, he broke apart into boulders that kept rolling, then stopped.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Gorrath breaking apart on the terraces into boulders that keep rolling, then stop. The carved stone heart in his chest cracks in two.

shots.text: Behind a fallen terrace we found what was left of the Canyon's shield-company. Gorrim Stonebeard was standing in front of them, with a stone door for a shield. Twenty years ago he had held the Kharum Pass beside Gorrath.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Gorrim Stonebeard, short and wide, a carved stone door as a shield, iron rings in his beard, standing in front of exhausted soldiers.

shots.text:
One iron ring in my beard for every friend I've buried. He makes thirty-two.

Let's not make it thirty-three.
shots.speaker: gorrim
shots.art_note: Gorrim braiding a new iron ring into his beard, then hefting the door-shield onto his back. Joins as a hero.
